Add SIDECAR_SERVICE and PLUGIN_CONTAINER Fetcher bindings so all execution
stays within Cloudflare infrastructure — no external sandbox bridge needed.

- plugin-dispatch.ts: read KV once per run (not 3×); use SIDECAR_SERVICE for
  lifecycle calls and PLUGIN_CONTAINER for executorMode="container" execution;
  add error check on record-result step; remove duplicate TODO comments
- api.ts: fix stale route-skipped comment to reflect current state

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
